state: New Gauss-constrained neutral ground; charged source creates odd sector and all computations use originating scalar angular metric, Gaussian cloud, static longitudinal Gauss solution and quantum magnetic vector modes. No old states or law imported.
units: hbar=1; charge=-1; lengths radius=1.1 and sigma=.35; angular inertias Ic=2, Ir=4, If=1.5; epsilon=.04; field omega=.8 and B amplitude=.45. No supplied c or mass conversion.

pure_functions.frame_gauss(): Returns full raw j=0,.5,1 x colour Fock4 Gauss generators, physical isometry P(56,4), N(4), physical left Noether S(3,4,4), dressed creation sources(2,4,4) and adverse bare sources. Physical basis ordered by N=0,1,1,2; odd-basis phase is eigensolver-dependent, so consume serialized sources and Noether together.
pure_functions.charge_geometry(p): Returns exact one-charge longitudinal Gaussian Coulomb energy and charge second-moment C1, both from same six clouds.
pure_functions.carrier(p,l,occupation): Returns full field-coupled one-K block H, L/S/J, total physical J including field, mu and shifted angular kinetic momenta. Restore 2l+1 identical K copies. N in {0,1,2}; ALL M and field occupations sum<=cutoff retained. Sum l=0..lmax for finite complete module.
pure_functions.spatial_consumer(p,k): Returns complete odd-charge W harmonics with ALL M,K,l<=lmax, full magnetic field states, density rho(k), physical current j(k) in three Cartesian directions and same H. For supplied input H(700,700), rho(700,700), current(3,700,700). This is the actual finite-q current root, not an imported Dirac gamma vertex.

serialized_exact_states.arrays: physical_projector, physical_number, physical_Noether, source, odd_H, odd_eigenvalues, odd_eigenvectors, source_vectors, spatial_H, spatial_current, spatial_density, current_legs, spatial_state, field_Q, magnetic_source, contact
serialized_exact_states.ordering: spatial basis loops l=0..2 then M=-l..l then K=-l..l; physical odd index after N diagonalization; field tuples (nx,ny,nz) nested ascending with nx+ny+nz<=2. np.kron ordering W, odd frame, field. Source vectors carry both physical source m labels, not separately normalized moment-labelled states.
serialized_exact_states.source_G: G_mn(z)=V_m^dag[z-(Hodd-Eneutral)]^-1 V_n, z=.9+.07i; source vectors V=d_m^dag|neutral>. Full source CAR Gram is identity, no low-pole repinning.
serialized_exact_states.current_insertion: current_vertex_3x2x2[a,m,n]=V_m^dag R(z) j_a(k) V_n. unamputated_threepoint_3x2x2=V^dag R(zout) j_a(k) R(zin) V; zin=.9+.07i,zout=1.1+.07i. This is unamputated, not a claimed QED Gamma or physical scattering amplitude.
serialized_exact_states.current_D: Current and field response matrices are source-leg positive-resolvent functions at z=.9+.07i with reference Eodd, not retarded commutator D with both positive/negative spectral terms. Complex real/imag JSON arrays preserve full phases. No spatial-photon D(q,omega) is exported by this local oscillator model.
serialized_exact_states.state_semantics: G is neutral-vacuum creation. Current/field leg Grams use a selected pure odd ground-doublet member; degeneracy matrices and exact eigenvectors are retained. N2 is two negative charges, not a positron. Electrostatic Gauss is reduced exactly and not a separate unconstrained Fock field.

consumer_limits: Do not join to a peer's photon law, mass or neutral minimizing family without constructing a compatible same-H extension. Natural-exit calculations are executed, independent review and final code diagnostics remain reviewer-owned.
